name: bash

commands.command:
/usr/bin/expect << "EOF"
set timeout -1
spawn make tests
expect eof
lassign [wait] _ _ _ value
exit $value
EOF
commands.source_command:
LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 su -s /usr/bin/expect tester << "EOF"
set timeout -1
spawn make tests
expect eof
lassign [wait] _ _ _ value
exit $value
EOF

test_expectations: run-builtins may fail on some host distributions at output lines 479 and 480
tests requiring zh_TW.BIG5 or ja_JP.SJIS may fail when those locales are unavailable
description: The Bash package contains the Bourne-Again Shell.

installed_descriptions.name: bash
installed_descriptions.description: A widely-used command interpreter; it performs many types of expansions and substitutions on a given command line before executing it, thus making this interpreter a powerful tool

installed_descriptions.name: bashbug
installed_descriptions.description: A shell script to help the user compose and mail standard formatted bug reports concerning bash

installed_descriptions.name: sh
installed_descriptions.description: A symlink to the bash program; when invoked as sh , bash tries to mimic the startup behavior of historical versions of sh as closely as possible, while conforming to the POSIX standard as well
